text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...! This energy surging through every 
fiber of my being...!?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Is this divine grace a gift from the 
Three Goddesses? 
—Regardless... I accept it with deepest 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of those I must lead— 
even if I must become an Asura, I shall 
carve our path forward.
